findings.title: Migration crashes when no embed category is configured
findings.body: This query returns no rows when `embed_category` is unset, which is a normal configuration; indexing `[0]['id']` then raises before the migration can apply. The fallback to the uncategorized category is never reached, so upgrades on affected sites are blocked. Handle the missing match before reading the result.

findings.title: Untrusted host setting is interpolated into migration SQL
findings.body: The legacy `embeddable_hosts` setting is interpolated directly into an SQL statement. A stored host containing a quote can break the migration, and crafted setting content can alter the SQL being executed during deployment. Use a bound parameter or properly quote each value.

findings.title: Valid hostnames with longer top-level domains are rejected
findings.body: The validation limits the final hostname label to 2–5 letters, so valid domains such as `example.museum` and `example.technology` cannot be added. Since host registration is required for embedding, sites using these domains cannot configure them.

findings.title: Updating a nonexistent host raises instead of returning a not-found response
findings.body: When the requested ID does not exist, `first` returns nil and `save_host` immediately assigns fields to that nil object. A stale admin page or invalid ID therefore produces a server error instead of a handled not-found response. The destroy action has the same nil dereference pattern.
